title: Multiomics Investigation of the Hypertensive Human Heart
tissue_model: human post-mortem left and right ventricle, bulk RNA-seq
contrast_description: positive log2FC = higher expression in hypertensive heart disease than in control
method: DESeq2 1.50.2 Wald test; pairing pooled: counts summed across each subject's LV+RV libraries (10 libraries -> 5 subjects), design ~ group, BH adjustment; DESeq2 independent filtering leaves padj NA for filtered genes
pairing_rationale: disease status is subject-level (each subject is HHD or control and contributes both LV and RV), so a subject fixed block is confounded with the contrast; DESeq2 has no random effects; pooling the paired libraries avoids pseudo-replication
symbol_mapping: org.Hs.eg.db 3.22.0 ENSEMBL -> SYMBOL (multiVals = first); unmapped Ensembl IDs dropped; duplicate symbols collapsed to the Ensembl ID with the highest mean CPM
exploratory_reason: 3 hypertensive vs 2 control subjects (n=5); the dataset survey records the series as exploratory because n=5 subjects cannot support a stable transcriptome-wide DEG list
description: EXPLORATORY — full-transcriptome DESeq2 HHD-vs-control differential expression on subject-pooled counts (paired LV+RV libraries summed per subject, 10 libraries -> 5 subjects; 3 HHD / 2 control). n=5 subjects cannot support a stable DEG list; this is a small-n reference only. Positive log2FC = higher in HHD. Hypertensive heart disease is a borderline >5% prevalence category (docs/research/stage2-stage3-gene-axis-datasets.md, 'Disease-prevalence taxonomy').
